title: Amazon Cognito M2M OAuth 2.0 with custom scopes and Amazon API Gateway
description: This pattern demonstrates how to implement machine-to-machine (M2M) authentication using Amazon Cognito, OAuth 2.0, Amazon API Gateway, and AWS Lambda.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern showcases the integration of Cognito as the authentication provider, allowing requests to be authorized based on custom scopes defined in OAuth 2.0.
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.

authors.name: Rushi Patel
authors.bio: Software Enginner at Cancer Research UK, passionate about event-driven architectures and Serverless.
